# Paths where taking upstream's version during a sync is CORRECT, and
# scripts/upstream-sync.sh verify should therefore not treat it as a dropped
# Flexion change.
#
# One path per line, exact match against a repository-relative path. Comments
# start with #. Keep this list short: every entry is a Flexion change you are
# agreeing to lose, so each one needs a reason next to it and should be removed
# again once it no longer applies.
#
# Add a path here only in the same PR that takes upstream's version, so the
# decision shows up in review as a visible diff instead of a silent revert.

# if flex changed dependencies, regenerate after the sync.
